newsitem.title: LATVIA: BOURSE FREE LIST SET FOR JULY 1.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE FREE LIST SET FOR JULY 1.

text.p: The Latvian stock exchange said on Friday that it will launch its new free list for less liquid small stocks on July 1.
The list will be the third after the official list and the secondary list.
"The bourse will introduce its free list from July 1," stock exchange president Uldis Cerps told a news conference.
The stock exchange had earlier said the new list may come into operation at the end of June.
The free list will include any firm that has securities commission approval to be publicly circulated.
The list has fewer rules than the other lists, including on information provision, with only annual reports rather than quartely reports, required.
